differential.name: Diabetic nephropathy leading to chronic kidney disease
differential.rationale: Long‑standing type 2 diabetes with proteinuria, microalbuminuria, CKD stages 1‑3 and elevated creatinine.

differential.name: Anemia of chronic disease secondary to CKD
differential.rationale: Persistent anemia in a patient with CKD and low erythropoietin production, without overt iron deficiency labs.

differential.name: Ischemic heart disease (stable coronary artery disease)
differential.rationale: Known IHD, dyslipidemia (high LDL, low HDL), hypertension and age place CAD as a major comorbidity.

differential.name: Hypertensive heart disease / heart failure with preserved ejection fraction
differential.rationale: Chronic hypertension, CKD, and anemia predispose to diastolic dysfunction and fluid overload (weight change pre/post dialysis).

differential.name: Fibromyalgia with chronic widespread pain
differential.rationale: Documented chronic low‑back pain, fibromyalgia diagnosis, and low pain score (3/10) despite multiple pain generators.
